consequence.statement: A runtime panic in the Loki Ruler that occurred under concurrent read-write access of tenant configs with large rule counts is resolved; no action is required.

original.statement: A panic caused by concurrent read-write access of tenant configs when there are a large amount of rules has been fixed in the Loki Ruler.

decision.reason: [ev-22d171f57c1e] lists this under Bug Fixes. It says a Ruler panic caused by concurrent read-write access of tenant configs with many rules has been fixed. Nothing in the excerpt says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or needs an operator step after the upgrade. The fix only removes a crash, so an environment that does nothing gets nothing it must act on, and "none" (informational) is the right consequence.
